slug: 2025-07-12 How Fayda powers Ethiopia's MESOB one-stop government platform

facts.fact: MESOB, the one-stop government service platform, uses Fayda as its authentication backbone, and citizens validate identity to access its services.
MOSIP/NIDP report MESOB gives access to 41 services across 12 federal institutions and serves 55 providers, all authenticated through Fayda.

note: as_of is the published date; the document gives no event date.
